campaigns.theme: Redes de comunidades judías y cristianas dentro del Imperio; el judaísmo posee una historia muy anterior al primer escenario.

narrator.name: Miriam of Caesarea
narrator.occupation: Copista y administradora de un archivo familiar
narrator.temperament: Curiosa, precisa, resistente a relatos triunfalistas; corrige sus primeras suposiciones.
narrator.backstory: Aprendió a comparar cartas heredadas; vivió las tensiones de comienzos del IV, no la Jerusalén del I.
narrator.knowledgeLimits: Los episodios del I/II llegan por escritos/tradición; solo el último pertenece a su vida.

voice.en: Natural English interpretation; no asserted ancient accent.
voice.es-ES: Interpretación natural en español; misma identidad y temperamento.

opening.en: My grandmother kept letters, not armies. I learned to read the gaps between them.
opening.es-ES: Mi abuela guardaba cartas, no ejércitos. Aprendí a leer los huecos entre ellas.

restrictions: No invented line is a historical quotation.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Reconstrucción de la circulación de comunidades del siglo I; los viajes individuales del jugador son ficticios. No se representa el origen del judaísmo como una decisión cristiana.

goals.en: Deliver three sealed letters along the Orontes roads.
goals.es-ES: Entrega tres cartas selladas por las rutas del Orontes.

goals.en: Secure food for two meeting houses without attacking their neighbours.
goals.es-ES: Asegura alimento para dos casas de reunión sin atacar a sus vecinos.

goals.en: Bring the returning courier safely to the south gate.
goals.es-ES: Lleva al correo de regreso sano a la puerta sur.

personalNarration.en: These letters were older than my grandmother. I cannot tell you their couriers’ names; I can tell you why a safe road mattered.
personalNarration.es-ES: Estas cartas eran anteriores a mi abuela. No puedo decirte quién las llevó; sí por qué importaba un camino seguro.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: Las redes siguen siendo diversas; la misión no produce una conversión automática.
scenarios.choice: Escoger ruta principal o alternativa: el hecho histórico y objetivos principales permanecen.
scenarios.recovery: Correo reemplazable por un único ayudante que recoge copia en archivo; una casa perdida no elimina la segunda vía.

failureRecovery.plan: Correo reemplazable por un único ayudante que recoge copia en archivo; una casa perdida no elimina la segunda vía.
failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

scenarios.historicalFrame: La destrucción de Jerusalén es histórica; la tradición cristiana sobre Pella es posterior y discutida en sus detalles. El convoy de familias mixtas es dramatización.

goals.en: Open the eastern evacuation corridor.
goals.es-ES: Abre el corredor oriental de evacuación.

goals.en: Escort at least six of eight family groups to the ridge refuge.

goals.en: Carry the surviving archive to the road beyond the siege.

personalNarration.en: One bundle names a place of refuge. It does not name everyone who failed to reach it. I will not fill that silence with certainty.
personalNarration.es-ES: Un legajo nombra un refugio. No nombra a todos los que no llegaron. No llenaré ese silencio con certeza.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: La ciudad y el Templo caen; salvar familias ficticias no cambia ese resultado.
scenarios.choice: Escoger ruta principal o alternativa: el hecho histórico y objetivos principales permanecen.
scenarios.recovery: Dos salidas: puerta oriental y senda sur. Pérdida de dos grupos tolerada en todos los niveles; archivo tiene una copia secundaria visible.

failureRecovery.plan: Dos salidas: puerta oriental y senda sur. Pérdida de dos grupos tolerada en todos los niveles; archivo tiene una copia secundaria visible.
failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Plinio y Trajano intercambian criterios de persecución. La red de mensajeros y la negociación sobre documentos son ficción acotada.

goals.en: Collect the two witness records before the patrol changes.

goals.en: Lead the households to a protected route without killing the witnesses.

personalNarration.en: A governor’s neat question reaches us intact. The anxious voices below it do not. Those voices are the part I must reconstruct.
personalNarration.es-ES: Nos llega intacta la pregunta pulcra de un gobernador. No las voces inquietas que quedan debajo. Esa parte debo reconstruirla.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: La correspondencia no impone tolerancia universal; se registra el alcance de la política.
scenarios.choice: Escoger ruta principal o alternativa: el hecho histórico y objetivos principales permanecen.
scenarios.recovery: Petición tiene copia en segundo archivo; intento fallido consume oro, abre ruta más larga con dos escoltas de reserva.

historicalBrief.en: Around 112, Pliny asked Trajan how to handle accusations against Christians. Their correspondence describes policy, not universal tolerance.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Las persecuciones de comienzos del IV y las disposiciones de 313 cambian el marco legal. El mapa representa la entrega final en 313; diez años se resumen en interludios.

goals.en: Reopen the archive and recover its two inventories.

goals.en: Supply the surviving households with 1200 food in audited deliveries.
goals.es-ES: Suministra 1200 de alimento a las familias supervivientes mediante entregas registradas.

goals.en: Choose which archive to follow next: imperial or Jewish communities.

personalNarration.en: This last ledger is mine. For once, I can tell you what I saw—and where fear made me look away.
personalNarration.es-ES: Este último registro es mío. Por una vez puedo decirte lo que vi, y dónde el miedo me hizo apartar la mirada.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: 313 enlaza con C01 por perspectiva cristiana y C02 por tradición judía; ambas permanecen disponibles.
scenarios.choice: Dos archivos finales, misma reconstrucción de 313; cada victoria guarda solo su clave a 1. Rejugar permite acumular ambas.
scenarios.recovery: Inventarios recuperables por ruta alternativa; las dos perspectivas nunca se cancelan entre sí.

failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

text.en: Embers of the Covenant
text.es-ES: Las brasas de la alianza

text.en: c. 50–313 CE. Follow Miriam of Caesarea through 4 scenarios. Each begins with a factual account, then a personal recollection. All campaigns can be played independently.
text.es-ES: c. 50–313 CE. Sigue a Miriam of Caesarea en 4 escenarios. Cada uno comienza con un relato de los hechos y después una memoria personal. Todas las campañas se pueden jugar de forma independiente.

text.en: The shared narrator gives the historical frame. The campaign narrator is a fictional person whose memories, songs and inherited accounts offer a situated perspective. Invented dialogue is never a historical quotation.
text.es-ES: El narrador común presenta el marco histórico. El narrador de campaña es un personaje ficticio cuya memoria, cantares y relatos heredados ofrecen una perspectiva situada. Los diálogos inventados nunca son citas históricas.

text.en: My grandmother kept letters, not armies. I learned to read the gaps between them.
text.es-ES: Mi abuela guardaba cartas, no ejércitos. Aprendí a leer los huecos entre ellas.

text.en: You may begin here. Dates on each scenario distinguish events from later memories. No earlier campaign is required.
text.es-ES: Puedes empezar aquí. Las fechas de cada escenario distinguen los hechos de las memorias posteriores. No necesitas una campaña anterior.

text.en: This campaign is complete. Your christian-perspective perspective is remembered. Recommended next: The Eagle and the Cross (CDF-C01; begins 28 October 312). You can also replay another perspective; previous choices remain recorded.
text.es-ES: Esta campaña ha terminado. Se recuerda tu perspectiva christian-perspective. Continúa con El águila y la cruz (CDF-C01; comienza en 28 October 312). También puedes rejugar otra perspectiva; se conservan las elecciones anteriores.

text.en: This campaign is complete. Your jewish-perspective perspective is remembered. Recommended next: Keepers of the Unbroken Word (CDF-C02; begins 70 CE). You can also replay another perspective; previous choices remain recorded.
text.es-ES: Esta campaña ha terminado. Se recuerda tu perspectiva jewish-perspective. Continúa con Guardianes de la palabra viva (CDF-C02; comienza en 70 CE). También puedes rejugar otra perspectiva; se conservan las elecciones anteriores.

title.en: The Eagle and the Cross
title.es-ES: El águila y la cruz

campaigns.theme: Poder imperial, cristianismo e instituciones; 312/325/330 conservan los tres escenarios existentes.

narrator.name: Marcus, the Imperial Clerk
narrator.occupation: Antiguo auxiliar de intendencia y copista de expedientes
narrator.temperament: Pragmático, irónico al hablar de suministros; se vuelve cauteloso al recordar favores del poder.
narrator.backstory: Joven en la campaña de 312; ayudó a transportar documentación en 325 y suministros en 330. Todo cargo y diálogo personal son ficticios.

opening.en: An eagle can be stitched onto a banner. Feeding the men beneath it is harder. That was my trade.

title.en: The Last Bridge to Rome
title.es-ES: El último puente hacia Roma

scenarios.historicalFrame: Constantino derrota a Majencio; fuentes difieren en sueño/signo. El despliegue y los pasos tácticos son reconstrucción, no datos exactos de ejército.

goals.en: Secure the northern approach and the supply road.
goals.es-ES: Asegura el acceso norte y el camino de suministros.

goals.en: Break the two defensive positions without losing your commander.

goals.en: Take the southern rally point and end the engagement.

personalNarration.en: I counted sacks on the northern road, not visions in the sky. Men spoke of signs; I knew only that the bridge left little room for hesitation.

scenarios.recovery: El puente permanente no puede destruirse antes de cruzar; dos corredores transitables. Posiciones destruidas anticipadamente cuentan al activarse el objetivo.

failureRecovery.plan: El puente permanente no puede destruirse antes de cruzar; dos corredores transitables. Posiciones destruidas anticipadamente cuentan al activarse el objetivo.
failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

scenarios.historicalFrame: El concilio formula credo y normas; disputas no equivalen a una división instantánea católica/ortodoxa. Fletes, alojamientos y sabotajes locales son dramatización.

goals.en: Receive the three delegations at the lakeside and northern gates.

goals.en: Deliver 900 food and two document chests to the meeting compound.

goals.en: Carry the agreed record to the southern departure point.

personalNarration.en: Every party wanted the best lodging. I learned their arguments while trying to find enough beds. The record would be firmer than my memory.
personalNarration.es-ES: Todos querían el mejor alojamiento. Aprendí sus argumentos intentando encontrar suficientes camas. El acta sería más firme que mi memoria.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: Se narra la decisión documentada; jugador resuelve logística, no verdad doctrinal.
scenarios.choice: Escoger ruta principal o alternativa: el hecho histórico y objetivos principales permanecen.
scenarios.recovery: Tres correos de reemplazo finitos; cofre destruido tiene copia en cancillería. Pérdida de barco abre camino terrestre al norte, sin repetir tributos.

historicalBrief.en: The council held at Nicaea in 325 issued a creed and disciplinary canons. Later church divisions did not emerge in a single day.

failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

failureRecovery.plan: Entrega en lotes con recibos únicos; recursos reservados para recuperar depósito; no exigir saldo final después de consumir el tributo.
failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

player.carriers: one noncombat carrier per task entity, all named fictional

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Phase waves use the separate local phase-two supply circuit, not the whole-map journey. Two round trips +90s loading/reaction fit the floor. Validate actual nav-path/speed and recompute before game approval.

text.en: 312–337 CE. Follow Marcus, the Imperial Clerk through 3 scenarios. Each begins with a factual account, then a personal recollection. All campaigns can be played independently.
text.es-ES: 312–337 CE. Sigue a Marcus, the Imperial Clerk en 3 escenarios. Cada uno comienza con un relato de los hechos y después una memoria personal. Todas las campañas se pueden jugar de forma independiente.

text.en: The shared narrator gives the historical frame. The campaign narrator is a fictional person whose memories, songs and inherited accounts offer a situated perspective. Invented dialogue is never a historical quotation.
text.es-ES: El narrador común presenta el marco histórico. El narrador de campaña es un personaje ficticio cuya memoria, cantares y relatos heredados ofrecen una perspectiva situada. Los diálogos inventados nunca son citas históricas.

text.en: An eagle can be stitched onto a banner. Feeding the men beneath it is harder. That was my trade.
text.es-ES: Un águila se puede coser a una bandera. Dar de comer a los hombres que marchan debajo cuesta más. Ese era mi oficio.

text.en: Recommended first: Embers of the Covenant (CDF-C00), christian-perspective. It explains the earlier setting. You can continue now; a recap follows. This campaign begins in 28 October 312, and may revisit an overlapping period.
text.es-ES: Se recomienda jugar antes Las brasas de la alianza (CDF-C00), ruta christian-perspective. Explica los antecedentes. Puedes continuar ahora; verás una recapitulación. Esta campaña comienza en 28 October 312 y puede volver a un período solapado.

narrator.name: Judith of Tiberias
narrator.occupation: Copista de cartas de familias y cuentas de viajeros
narrator.temperament: Meticulosa, humor seco, protectora del desacuerdo y de los nombres individuales.
narrator.backstory: Aprendió en Galilea y reunió testimonios heredados de varias ciudades; su abuela solo conocía parte de esa historia.

opening.es-ES: Una línea dañada sigue siendo una línea. La copio con su hueco, para que nadie confunda mi suposición con palabras ajenas.

failureRecovery.plan: Tres legajos con copia redundante; refugios sur y este equivalentes. No misión de suicidio ni premio por matar civiles.
failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.

Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

failureRecovery.plan: No bloquear cuadrícula: dos calles mínimas 8 casillas. Reenvío de una caravana con stock fijo; mezquitas del VII ausentes.
failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

player.carriers: one noncombat carrier per task entity, all named fictional

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Phase waves use the separate local phase-two supply circuit, not the whole-map journey. Two round trips +90s loading/reaction fit the floor. Validate actual nav-path/speed and recompute before game approval.

text.en: Keepers of the Unbroken Word
text.es-ES: Guardianes de la palabra viva

text.en: 70–c. 425 CE. Follow Judith of Tiberias through 4 scenarios. Each begins with a factual account, then a personal recollection. All campaigns can be played independently.
text.es-ES: 70–c. 425 CE. Sigue a Judith of Tiberias en 4 escenarios. Cada uno comienza con un relato de los hechos y después una memoria personal. Todas las campañas se pueden jugar de forma independiente.

text.en: The shared narrator gives the historical frame. The campaign narrator is a fictional person whose memories, songs and inherited accounts offer a situated perspective. Invented dialogue is never a historical quotation.
text.es-ES: El narrador común presenta el marco histórico. El narrador de campaña es un personaje ficticio cuya memoria, cantares y relatos heredados ofrecen una perspectiva situada. Los diálogos inventados nunca son citas históricas.

text.en: A damaged line is still a line. I copy it with the gap intact, so that no one mistakes my guess for another person’s word.
text.es-ES: Una línea dañada sigue siendo una línea. La copio con su hueco, para que nadie confunda mi suposición con palabras ajenas.

text.en: Recommended first: Embers of the Covenant (CDF-C00), jewish-perspective. It explains the earlier setting. You can continue now; a recap follows. This campaign begins in 70 CE, and may revisit an overlapping period.
text.es-ES: Se recomienda jugar antes Las brasas de la alianza (CDF-C00), ruta jewish-perspective. Explica los antecedentes. Puedes continuar ahora; verás una recapitulación. Esta campaña comienza en 70 CE y puede volver a un período solapado.

campaigns.theme: Una ciudad, su abastecimiento y sus instituciones entre autoridad imperial, obispos y reyes.

narrator.name: Leo of the Roman Roads
narrator.occupation: Cantor itinerante y escribiente ocasional en hospicios
narrator.temperament: Ingenioso, cálido y propenso a exagerar distancias; nunca a convertir una exageración en fecha.
narrator.backstory: Creció con relatos de caminantes y canta en posadas; presenció Roma alrededor de 800. Su repertorio sobre siglos anteriores se basa en lecturas de archivo.
narrator.knowledgeLimits: No afirma presencia en 410/595/756; canta hechos ajenos y lo declara.

voice.en: Natural English interpretation; no asserted ancient accent.
voice.es-ES: Interpretación natural en español; misma identidad y temperamento.

opening.en: A road gives a singer a chorus. A city gives him too many verses. Listen for the difference between a song and a record.
opening.es-ES: Un camino da al cantor un estribillo. Una ciudad le da demasiadas estrofas. Escucha la diferencia entre una canción y un registro.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Saqueo de Roma; Agustín escribe sobre protección en ciertos santuarios. Ruta de víveres y familias del jugador son dramatización.

personalNarration.en: The old verses boast of gates and kings. The account beneath them speaks of refuge. I sing the smaller word first.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: No se derrota a Alarico para impedir el saqueo; conservar vidas ficticias es victoria jugable.
scenarios.choice: Escoger ruta principal o alternativa: el hecho histórico y objetivos principales permanecen.
scenarios.recovery: Muelles y vía terrestre; convoy único de recuperación coste 300 oro. No exigir destruir a todos los sitiadores.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

failureRecovery.plan: Un pago por control; intento fallido no consume ambos presupuestos. Correo reemplazable y ruta de mayor escolta sin peaje.
failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

player.carriers: one noncombat carrier per task entity, all named fictional

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Phase waves use the separate local phase-two supply circuit, not the whole-map journey. Two round trips +90s loading/reaction fit the floor. Validate actual nav-path/speed and recompute before game approval.

entities.replacement: one recovery carrier may inherit the SAME token ID; never mint another counted object
entities.originRule: one distinct pickup position per token in its initial district; carriers separated by 1–2 tiles within allowed footprint; no origin inside receiving zone

player.carriers: one noncombat carrier per task entity, all named fictional

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Phase waves use the separate local phase-two supply circuit, not the whole-map journey. Two round trips +90s loading/reaction fit the floor. Validate actual nav-path/speed and recompute before game approval.

worldContract.ledgerPolicy: persist exact object IDs, allocations, receipt flags, pairing and phase. Compound objectives require EVERY listed requirement; shared families/copies retain identity between phases.
worldContract.resourcePolicy: protected-recovery is separate from spendable; no double-count in ledgers; no infinite consignment or fifth engine resource

worldContract.enemyBinding: Bind every military-guard and military-post entity to a unique initialEnemy roster member. They consume that budget; never add objective guards on top of initial composition.

All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.

text.en: The Keys of the Eternal City
text.es-ES: Las llaves de la Ciudad Eterna

text.en: 337–800 CE; missions 410–800. Follow Leo of the Roman Roads through 4 scenarios. Each begins with a factual account, then a personal recollection. All campaigns can be played independently.
text.es-ES: 337–800 CE; missions 410–800. Sigue a Leo of the Roman Roads en 4 escenarios. Cada uno comienza con un relato de los hechos y después una memoria personal. Todas las campañas se pueden jugar de forma independiente.

text.en: The shared narrator gives the historical frame. The campaign narrator is a fictional person whose memories, songs and inherited accounts offer a situated perspective. Invented dialogue is never a historical quotation.
text.es-ES: El narrador común presenta el marco histórico. El narrador de campaña es un personaje ficticio cuya memoria, cantares y relatos heredados ofrecen una perspectiva situada. Los diálogos inventados nunca son citas históricas.

text.en: A road gives a singer a chorus. A city gives him too many verses. Listen for the difference between a song and a record.
text.es-ES: Un camino da al cantor un estribillo. Una ciudad le da demasiadas estrofas. Escucha la diferencia entre una canción y un registro.

text.en: Recommended first: The Eagle and the Cross (CDF-C01), western-perspective. It explains the earlier setting. You can continue now; a recap follows. This campaign begins in 410 CE, and may revisit an overlapping period.
text.es-ES: Se recomienda jugar antes El águila y la cruz (CDF-C01), ruta western-perspective. Explica los antecedentes. Puedes continuar ahora; verás una recapitulación. Esta campaña comienza en 410 CE y puede volver a un período solapado.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Phase waves use the separate local phase-two supply circuit, not the whole-map journey. Two round trips +90s loading/reaction fit the floor. Validate actual nav-path/speed and recompute before game approval.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Phase waves use the separate local phase-two supply circuit, not the whole-map journey. Two round trips +90s loading/reaction fit the floor. Validate actual nav-path/speed and recompute before game approval.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Phase waves use the separate local phase-two supply circuit, not the whole-map journey. Two round trips +90s loading/reaction fit the floor. Validate actual nav-path/speed and recompute before game approval.

worldContract.ledgerPolicy: persist exact object IDs, allocations, receipt flags, pairing and phase. Compound objectives require EVERY listed requirement; shared families/copies retain identity between phases.
worldContract.resourcePolicy: protected-recovery is separate from spendable; no double-count in ledgers; no infinite consignment or fifth engine resource
worldContract.defeatPolicy: below required possible survivors is unrecoverable; recoverable carriers retain their token via one helper; historical deaths remain narrated, not killable units

worldContract.enemyBinding: Bind every military-guard and military-post entity to a unique initialEnemy roster member. They consume that budget; never add objective guards on top of initial composition.

failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit
entityRepresentation.recovery: four preplaced guards released once with protected resources, persisting after save/load

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Phase waves use the separate local phase-two supply circuit, not the whole-map journey. Two round trips +90s loading/reaction fit the floor. Validate actual nav-path/speed and recompute before game approval.

worldContract.ledgerPolicy: persist exact object IDs, allocations, receipt flags, pairing and phase. Compound objectives require EVERY listed requirement; shared families/copies retain identity between phases.
worldContract.resourcePolicy: protected-recovery is separate from spendable; no double-count in ledgers; no infinite consignment or fifth engine resource

worldContract.enemyBinding: Bind every military-guard and military-post entity to a unique initialEnemy roster member. They consume that budget; never add objective guards on top of initial composition.

Se ocupa de el inventario de reparación; ofrece la ventaja táctica o contextual indicada sin alterar el desenlace histórico. No introduce bajas históricas concretas ni diálogos privados.

text.en: Recover both separate copies from the repair inventory and deliver them to the copyist. Benefit: unlock a historical note and an explicit main-goal hint.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Nicea II condena la iconoclasia en 787; esta vuelve en 815 y es condenada en 843. No existe final lineal ininterrumpido desde 787.

goals.en: Gather the three workshop records without destroying opposing archives.

goals.en: Deposit two copies and preserve one inventory for the future.

personalNarration.en: I was old enough to work in 787, and old enough to doubt my first certainty when the policy changed again. A restored image does not restore a lost life.
personalNarration.es-ES: Ya podía trabajar en 787, y pude dudar de mi primera certeza cuando cambió de nuevo la política. Restaurar una imagen no devuelve una vida perdida.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: 787 misión; Anna anciana relata 843. Recomendaciones a C03 e I02 son perspectivas paralelas; 1054 requiere nueva campaña.
scenarios.choice: Escoger ruta principal o alternativa: el hecho histórico y objetivos principales permanecen.
scenarios.recovery: Dos custodios de reemplazo con documentos duplicados; ninguna eliminación doctrinal de rivales. No cambiar mapa de Nicea a Constantinopla por un timer.

failureRecovery.plan: Dos custodios de reemplazo con documentos duplicados; ninguna eliminación doctrinal de rivales. No cambiar mapa de Nicea a Constantinopla por un timer.
failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Phase waves use the separate local phase-two supply circuit, not the whole-map journey. Two round trips +90s loading/reaction fit the floor. Validate actual nav-path/speed and recompute before game approval.

worldContract.ledgerPolicy: persist exact object IDs, allocations, receipt flags, pairing and phase. Compound objectives require EVERY listed requirement; shared families/copies retain identity between phases.
worldContract.resourcePolicy: protected-recovery is separate from spendable; no double-count in ledgers; no infinite consignment or fifth engine resource

text.en: Beyond the Golden Gate
text.es-ES: Más allá de la Puerta Dorada

text.en: 337–843 CE; missions 451–787. Follow Anna, the Mosaic Restorer through 5 scenarios. Each begins with a factual account, then a personal recollection. All campaigns can be played independently.
text.es-ES: 337–843 CE; missions 451–787. Sigue a Anna, the Mosaic Restorer en 5 escenarios. Cada uno comienza con un relato de los hechos y después una memoria personal. Todas las campañas se pueden jugar de forma independiente.

text.en: The shared narrator gives the historical frame. The campaign narrator is a fictional person whose memories, songs and inherited accounts offer a situated perspective. Invented dialogue is never a historical quotation.
text.es-ES: El narrador común presenta el marco histórico. El narrador de campaña es un personaje ficticio cuya memoria, cantares y relatos heredados ofrecen una perspectiva situada. Los diálogos inventados nunca son citas históricas.

text.en: A wall keeps more than stones. Every repair tells me what someone before us chose to keep—or to erase.
text.es-ES: Un muro conserva algo más que piedras. Cada reparación cuenta qué quiso alguien conservar, o borrar.

text.en: Recommended first: The Eagle and the Cross (CDF-C01), eastern-perspective. It explains the earlier setting. You can continue now; a recap follows. This campaign begins in 451 CE, and may revisit an overlapping period.
text.es-ES: Se recomienda jugar antes El águila y la cruz (CDF-C01), ruta eastern-perspective. Explica los antecedentes. Puedes continuar ahora; verás una recapitulación. Esta campaña comienza en 451 CE y puede volver a un período solapado.

title.en: Beneath the Desert Stars

campaigns.theme: Asentamientos, expansión y gobiernos de la comunidad; conquistas militares no significan conversiones instantáneas.

narrator.name: Salim, the Caravan Scribe
narrator.temperament: Observador concreto, hospitalario, orgulloso de conocer pozos; inquieto cuando las rutas dejan de ser seguras.
narrator.backstory: Llegó joven a Medina en 622 en una caravana ficticia; su oficio le permitió acompañar redes de abastecimiento, no asistir a cada batalla como consejero omnisciente.
narrator.knowledgeLimits: Explica qué vio del camino y qué le contaron soldados; no narra pensamientos/revelaciones del Profeta.

voice.en: Natural English interpretation; no asserted ancient accent.
voice.es-ES: Interpretación natural en español; misma identidad y temperamento.

opening.en: I knew the sky by its stars and a road by its wells. Then the roads began to lead farther than any ledger I had carried.
opening.es-ES: Conocía el cielo por sus estrellas y el camino por sus pozos. Después los caminos llegaron más lejos que cualquier registro que había llevado.

scenarios.historicalFrame: La Hégira a Medina abre el marco del relato. La distribución de pozos a cargo de Salim y la caravana son ficción; no se combate para verificar la revelación.

goals.en: Link the three wells to the receiving households.

personalNarration.en: I was sixteen and certain I could judge a town by the price of water. Medina taught me to learn the names before counting the jars.

scenarios.recovery: Pozo bloqueado temporalmente tiene ruta a segundo pozo. Destrucción de un almacén habilita entrega alternativa, no partida irrecuperable.

failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.

Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance

economicAnalysis.travelTime: Phase waves use the separate local phase-two supply circuit, not the whole-map journey. Two round trips +90s loading/reaction fit the floor. Validate actual nav-path/speed and recompute before game approval.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

worldContract.ledgerPolicy: persist exact object IDs, allocations, receipt flags, pairing and phase. Compound objectives require EVERY listed requirement; shared families/copies retain identity between phases.
worldContract.resourcePolicy: protected-recovery is separate from spendable; no double-count in ledgers; no infinite consignment or fifth engine resource
worldContract.defeatPolicy: below required possible survivors is unrecoverable; recoverable carriers retain their token via one helper; historical deaths remain narrated, not killable units

worldContract.enemyBinding: Bind every military-guard and military-post entity to a unique initialEnemy roster member. They consume that budget; never add objective guards on top of initial composition.

rationale.en: The documented setting of The Roads of Yamama supports this bounded fictional local task. It concerns the convoy departure copies; it grants the stated tactical or contextual benefit without reversing the historical outcome. It introduces no named historical casualty or private dialogue.

personalNarration.en: From the supply line I saw dust before I saw standards. Later I heard tidy accounts of the battle. My own account begins with the men returning thirsty.

failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

entityRepresentation.record: named noncombat carrier with physical copy object/token, no magical relic bonus
entityRepresentation.wagon: Trade Cart visual proxy with trading disabled; fixed consignments and no renewable trade gold
entityRepresentation.family: named villager groups, no farming/economic AI when representing escorted parties
entityRepresentation.military-post: Watch Tower base DE proxy; two objectives have stable unit IDs, unrelated civilians excluded
entityRepresentation.water: named noncombat consignment, amount of water is narrative inventory, not an undocumented fifth engine resource
entityRepresentation.commander: named fictional Militia proxy, essential only when objective explicitly requires commander; no sacred unit

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Phase waves use the separate local phase-two supply circuit, not the whole-map journey. Two round trips +90s loading/reaction fit the floor. Validate actual nav-path/speed and recompute before game approval.

worldContract.ledgerPolicy: persist exact object IDs, allocations, receipt flags, pairing and phase. Compound objectives require EVERY listed requirement; shared families/copies retain identity between phases.

representation.technology: Feudal maximum by default; no gunpowder, modern fortifications, monks converting faith, unique units, trebuchets or late plate-armoured knights. Battering ram is an explicit visual/technology proxy where military outposts must fall.

artDirection.medium: Painted historical illustration, map first; contemporary reference photos are for research only.
artDirection.cover: Beneath the Desert Stars: Yathrib / Medina oasis, 622 CE; foreground Administrador de caravanas y suministros; no modern skyline or invented sacred portrait.
artDirection.portrait: Fictional Salim, the Caravan Scribe, occupational props, plain clothing without fabricated uniform; expression follows temperament. Label composite fictional narrator in credits.
artDirection.delivery: One cover, one narrator portrait, one context map per scenario; licensed or original PNG; no paid batch authorized.

text.en: Beneath the Desert Stars
text.es-ES: Bajo las estrellas del desierto

text.en: 622–656 CE. Follow Salim, the Caravan Scribe through 5 scenarios. Each begins with a factual account, then a personal recollection. All campaigns can be played independently.
text.es-ES: 622–656 CE. Sigue a Salim, the Caravan Scribe en 5 escenarios. Cada uno comienza con un relato de los hechos y después una memoria personal. Todas las campañas se pueden jugar de forma independiente.

text.en: The shared narrator gives the historical frame. The campaign narrator is a fictional person whose memories, songs and inherited accounts offer a situated perspective. Invented dialogue is never a historical quotation.
text.es-ES: El narrador común presenta el marco histórico. El narrador de campaña es un personaje ficticio cuya memoria, cantares y relatos heredados ofrecen una perspectiva situada. Los diálogos inventados nunca son citas históricas.

text.en: I knew the sky by its stars and a road by its wells. Then the roads began to lead farther than any ledger I had carried.
text.es-ES: Conocía el cielo por sus estrellas y el camino por sus pozos. Después los caminos llegaron más lejos que cualquier registro que había llevado.

text.en: You may begin here. Dates on each scenario distinguish events from later memories. No earlier campaign is required.
text.es-ES: Puedes empezar aquí. Las fechas de cada escenario distinguen los hechos de las memorias posteriores. No necesitas una campaña anterior.

text.en: This campaign is complete. Your completed perspective is remembered. Recommended next: The Shattered Oath (CDF-I01; begins 656 CE). You can also replay another perspective; previous choices remain recorded.
text.es-ES: Esta campaña ha terminado. Se recuerda tu perspectiva completed. Continúa con El juramento quebrado (CDF-I01; comienza en 656 CE). También puedes rejugar otra perspectiva; se conservan las elecciones anteriores.

campaigns.theme: Guerra civil y autoridad en disputa; las tradiciones posteriores no son dos bloques ya acabados en 656.

narrator.name: Farid, the Field Medic
narrator.occupation: Auxiliar de enfermería militar y escriba de listas de bajas
narrator.temperament: Contenido, desconfiado de consignas, atento a detalles materiales; simpatías explícitas, ninguna omnisciencia moral.
narrator.backstory: Trabajó con redes de auxilio iraquíes; conoce distintos campamentos por traslados ficticios y relatos. No es consejero documentado de Ali o Muawiya.
narrator.knowledgeLimits: La medicina es dramatización sin milagros; distingue conversación oída y relato posterior; nunca convierte heridos en recursos.

voice.en: Natural English interpretation; no asserted ancient accent.
voice.es-ES: Interpretación natural en español; misma identidad y temperamento.

opening.en: I learned which camp a man came from after I had bound the wound. Before that, I knew only that he needed help.
opening.es-ES: Aprendía de qué campamento venía un hombre después de vendarle la herida. Antes solo sabía que necesitaba ayuda.

failureRecovery.plan: Dos correos sustituibles por único tercero en depósito. Los despachos no se destruyen en inventario; copia si portador cae.
failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.
