tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Phase waves use the separate local phase-two supply circuit, not the whole-map journey. Two round trips +90s loading/reaction fit the floor. Validate actual nav-path/speed and recompute before game approval.

rationale.es-ES: El contexto documentado de Entre los campamentos permite esta tarea local ficticia y limitada. Se ocupa de las aproximaciones al corredor seco; ofrece la ventaja táctica o contextual indicada sin alterar el desenlace histórico. No introduce bajas históricas concretas ni diálogos privados.

text.en: Scout both marked viewpoints of the dry corridor approaches. Benefit: reveal the second reserve approach.
text.es-ES: Explora los dos miradores señalados de las aproximaciones al corredor seco. Ventaja: revela la aproximación de la segunda reserva.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance
economicAnalysis.walkingAndIdleIncluded: Assumed rate discounts native gathering for travel/idle; measure actual efficiency in game.
economicAnalysis.sensitivity: At 50% of assumed efficiency recompute delivery window; do not spawn hidden resources. Split workers 50%food/25%wood/20%gold/5%stone, change allocation when a specified delivery requires stone.
economicAnalysis.travelTime: Phase waves use the separate local phase-two supply circuit, not the whole-map journey. Two round trips +90s loading/reaction fit the floor. Validate actual nav-path/speed and recompute before game approval.

failureRecovery.plan: Dos cruces, carro crítico no se queda en canal por edificio construido. Un relevo finito en retaguardia; no orden irreversible hasta paso del convoy.
failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Ali muere; Hasan acuerda ceder gobierno a Muawiya después. Se conserva secuencia y se separan interpretaciones de los acuerdos.

goals.en: Return the civilian parties to the two receiving districts.

personalNarration.en: Both archives kept a date. They did not keep the same memory. I carried a copy to each, knowing neither could hold the whole river.
personalNarration.es-ES: Ambos archivos guardaron una fecha. No guardaron la misma memoria. Llevé una copia a cada uno, sabiendo que ninguno contenía todo el río.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: Epílogos remiten I02 por Muawiya o I03 por Ali. La elección es lectura posterior; no sobrevivencia alternativa de Ali.
scenarios.choice: Dos destinos de lectura: guardar una clave por partida; replay acumula ambas. Ambos mensajes dan fecha/ID de sucesora y aviso de solapamiento.
scenarios.recovery: Registros tienen copia en administración. Elección final solo después de ambos recibos; prioridad de destinos simultáneos fija y comprobada.

historicalBrief.en: Ali died in 661. Hasan’s agreement with Muawiya was a distinct subsequent development, not the same event.

failureRecovery.plan: Registros tienen copia en administración. Elección final solo después de ambos recibos; prioridad de destinos simultáneos fija y comprobada.
failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

text.en: The Shattered Oath

text.en: 656–661 CE. Follow Farid, the Field Medic through 5 scenarios. Each begins with a factual account, then a personal recollection. All campaigns can be played independently.

text.en: The shared narrator gives the historical frame. The campaign narrator is a fictional person whose memories, songs and inherited accounts offer a situated perspective. Invented dialogue is never a historical quotation.

text.en: I learned which camp a man came from after I had bound the wound. Before that, I knew only that he needed help.

title.en: From Damascus to the Far Horizon
title.es-ES: De Damasco al último horizonte

campaigns.theme: Administración, obras y expansión de un imperio diverso; el final omeya de 750 no acaba su linaje ni inaugura homogeneidad social.

narrator.name: Yasir, the Cloth Merchant
narrator.occupation: Mercader de tejidos y portador de cuentas entre talleres
narrator.temperament: Ambicioso, curioso y buen negociador; aprende a reconocer los costes escondidos de un triunfo.
narrator.backstory: Su madre trabajó con redes de talleres levantinos; creció entre rutas de Damasco. Describe 661/691/698 por cuentas familiares y 711 por relatos de infancia, no como general presente.
narrator.knowledgeLimits: Solo años adultos pueden ser vivencia directa; mapa comercial no representa fronteras políticas exactas.

voice.en: Natural English interpretation; no asserted ancient accent.
voice.es-ES: Interpretación natural en español; misma identidad y temperamento.

opening.en: My first map was a list of debts. The empire looked boundless until I learned how far a promise could travel before it broke.
opening.es-ES: Mi primer mapa era una lista de deudas. El imperio parecía no tener límite hasta que aprendí cuán lejos podía viajar una promesa antes de romperse.

restrictions: No invented line is a historical quotation.

No eyewitness claims outside lifespan or location.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.

Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Construcción de la Cúpula de la Roca bajo Abd al-Malik. Fecha691/692 y acabado original se distinguen de restauraciones posteriores.

goals.en: Bring the stone and timber consignments to the works gate.
goals.es-ES: Lleva los envíos de piedra y madera a la puerta de las obras.

goals.en: Supply 1000 food and preserve the two district water routes.
goals.es-ES: Abastece 1000 de alimento y preserva las dos rutas de agua de barrio.

goals.en: Complete the building account without damaging neighbouring sites.
goals.es-ES: Completa la cuenta de construcción sin dañar los recintos vecinos.

failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Cambio de poder en Cartago dentro de expansión norteafricana; el convoy y táctica costera son reconstrucción. Fecha y secuencia regional requieren fuente específica del dossier.

goals.en: Secure the inland road before entering the port quarter.

goals.en: Take two military depots while allowing the civilian ships to leave.

personalNarration.en: The family account lists cloth sent west and a ship that did not return. It says nothing of a glorious empty shore.
personalNarration.es-ES: La cuenta familiar enumera telas enviadas al oeste y un barco que no regresó. No habla de una gloriosa orilla vacía.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: No quemar población ni asegurar desaparición de culturas romano-africanas por victoria.
scenarios.choice: Escoger ruta principal o alternativa: el hecho histórico y objetivos principales permanecen.
scenarios.recovery: Terrestre interior alternativa a muelle; naves civiles acaban recorrido fuera de zona de combate. Depósitos capturados no deben convertirse y reconstruirse indefinidamente.

historicalBrief.en: Carthage passed out of Byzantine control in 698. The harbour operation here is a tactical reconstruction with civilian departure protected.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.

Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

phaseDeadlines.en: Timed phases: o1: 30 / 25 / 20 minutes on Easy / Standard / Hard. The countdown starts when that phase begins; a two-minute warning precedes a loss if its task is unfinished.
phaseDeadlines.es-ES: Fases con plazo: o1: 30 / 25 / 20 minutos en fácil / estándar / difícil. La cuenta empieza al comenzar esa fase; un aviso de dos minutos precede a la derrota si falta su objetivo.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

text.en: From Damascus to the Far Horizon
text.es-ES: De Damasco al último horizonte

text.en: 661–750 CE. Follow Yasir, the Cloth Merchant through 5 scenarios. Each begins with a factual account, then a personal recollection. All campaigns can be played independently.
text.es-ES: 661–750 CE. Sigue a Yasir, the Cloth Merchant en 5 escenarios. Cada uno comienza con un relato de los hechos y después una memoria personal. Todas las campañas se pueden jugar de forma independiente.

text.en: The shared narrator gives the historical frame. The campaign narrator is a fictional person whose memories, songs and inherited accounts offer a situated perspective. Invented dialogue is never a historical quotation.
text.es-ES: El narrador común presenta el marco histórico. El narrador de campaña es un personaje ficticio cuya memoria, cantares y relatos heredados ofrecen una perspectiva situada. Los diálogos inventados nunca son citas históricas.

text.en: My first map was a list of debts. The empire looked boundless until I learned how far a promise could travel before it broke.
text.es-ES: Mi primer mapa era una lista de deudas. El imperio parecía no tener límite hasta que aprendí cuán lejos podía viajar una promesa antes de romperse.

text.en: Recommended first: The Shattered Oath (CDF-I01), muawiya-perspective. It explains the earlier setting. You can continue now; a recap follows. This campaign begins in 661 CE, and may revisit an overlapping period.
text.es-ES: Se recomienda jugar antes El juramento quebrado (CDF-I01), ruta muawiya-perspective. Explica los antecedentes. Puedes continuar ahora; verás una recapitulación. Esta campaña comienza en 661 CE y puede volver a un período solapado.

title.en: The River Remembers
title.es-ES: El río recuerda

campaigns.theme: Red familiar y memoria de Ali, Hasan y Husayn; perspectivas y tradiciones comunitarias se atribuyen, nunca se representan como verdades ganadas con armas.

narrator.name: Dina of the Riverbank
narrator.occupation: Alfarera y proveedora de vasijas para familias viajeras
narrator.temperament: Directa, compasiva, resistente a consignas; humor doméstico al principio y duelo contenido al final.
narrator.backstory: Creció en redes de Kufa. Las primeras historias llegan por su tío; adulta prepara suministros de una caravana ficticia cercana a los caminos de 680. No figura como testigo documentado del círculo de Husayn.
narrator.knowledgeLimits: No puede recordar como adulta 656/657; la memoria doméstica es ficción transparente, no relato canónico del martirio.

voice.en: Natural English interpretation; no asserted ancient accent.
voice.es-ES: Interpretación natural en español; misma identidad y temperamento.

opening.en: A jar remembers the hand that shaped it. A family remembers more, and not always in the same way. I will tell you which memories are mine.
opening.es-ES: Una vasija conserva la mano que le dio forma. Una familia guarda más, y no siempre de la misma manera. Te diré qué recuerdos son míos.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.

Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

economicAnalysis.classification: feasibility envelope, not a combat simulation or proof of balance

title.en: A Cup at Siffin
title.es-ES: Un cuenco en Siffin

scenarios.historicalFrame: Mismo marco de Siffin que I01 con otro objetivo y enfoque; no otro resultado histórico ni contradicción entre las campañas.

goals.en: Prepare the two aid wagons on the Iraqi approach.
goals.es-ES: Prepara los dos carros de auxilio en el acceso iraquí.

goals.en: Carry the supplies to both appointed truce points.
goals.es-ES: Lleva los suministros a los dos puntos de tregua designados.

goals.en: Return the receiving records and six civilian parties.
goals.es-ES: Devuelve los recibos y seis grupos civiles.

personalNarration.en: My uncle brought back a chipped cup and three versions of a single afternoon. I kept the cup; I learned to name the versions.
personalNarration.es-ES: Mi tío volvió con un cuenco roto y tres versiones de una misma tarde. Guardé el cuenco; aprendí a nombrar las versiones.

failureRecovery.budget: One reserve escort only, drawn from protected stock and accounted starting reserve; no infinite recruit loop.
failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

tacticalRoster.proxyCautions: These are engine proxies. No generic religious race, no monks representing forced belief. Enemy units are military/raider gameplay groups, not every neighbouring civilian.

title.en: The Sealed Copy
title.es-ES: La copia sellada

scenarios.historicalFrame: Muerte de Ali y acuerdo de Hasan con Muawiya son acontecimientos distintos. Diferencias en memorias de las condiciones del pacto se señalan.

goals.en: Recover the two public registers and family copy.
goals.es-ES: Recupera los dos registros públicos y la copia familiar.

goals.en: Escort their custodians to separate departure roads.
goals.es-ES: Escolta a sus custodios hasta caminos de salida separados.

goals.en: Seal the copies and leave provisions for the households remaining in Kufa.
goals.es-ES: Sella las copias y deja víveres a las familias que permanecen en Kufa.

personalNarration.en: At sixteen I knew enough to carry a sealed copy and too little to declare whose account would become the last one.
personalNarration.es-ES: A los dieciséis sabía lo suficiente para llevar una copia sellada y demasiado poco para declarar qué relato sería el definitivo.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

scenarios.historicalFrame: Husayn muere en Karbala; números/discursos y motivos detallados varían según transmisión. Misión acompaña viajeros ficticios fuera del campamento histórico, no recrea el martirio como espectáculo.

personalNarration.en: I was old enough now to know a road could close. I filled the jars before asking which story would be told about the men beyond it.
personalNarration.es-ES: Ahora tenía edad para saber que un camino podía cerrarse. Llené las vasijas antes de preguntar qué historia se contaría de los hombres que quedaban al otro lado.

scenarios.historicalOutcome: Narrador común expone la muerte documentada sobriamente; Dina cierra su experiencia ficticia sin atribuirse diálogos de Husayn. Memoria posterior se contextualiza.
scenarios.choice: Salvar más familias o recuperar segundo testimonio como bonus: ninguno cambia 680 ni desbloquea una religión. Recomendar I02 para perspectiva política paralela.
scenarios.recovery: Personajes venerados fuera de mapa/no derrotables; convoy de familias ficticias. Dos pozos/rutas con presupuesto visible y un último relevo limitado; sin final histórico alternativo.

failureRecovery.notDefeat: Historical fall, sack, defeat or death of an off-map documented figure is narrative context. Player defeat is failing this mission’s rescue/supply/tactical task.
failureRecovery.deadlockDetection: No objective progress for 6 game minutes shows the exact outstanding goal and route, with optional recovery reminder. No automatic victory.
failureRecovery.abuse: Killing civilian neighbours gives no gold/score. Essential historical figures are off-map narrative subjects, never convertable units.

qa.expected: All narrator facts link to claim/source; uncertainty spoken when essential; fictional dialogue labelled.
Landmark banks and coast orientation match regional controls; no anachronisms listed in profile.
Flood fill with unit footprint, bridge/naval checks; land routes cannot jump water; largest convoy reaches all goals.
Targets destroyed/archives saved before activation latch and unlock later objectives.
Save before/after every delivery and wave; reload cannot duplicate or lose counts.
Roster initial plus three waves <= cap in each difficulty; all enemy production off.
Lose one courier/boat or two families; documented fallback exists without repeating payments.
Normal success rates 60–80% familiar AoE2 cohort, easy 80–95% learning cohort, hard 35–60% expert blind cohort: hypotheses, not measurements.
General factual brief then campaign person; no omniscience or lived memory before birth.
All screens EN and es-ES, 17 full destination catalogs reviewed for release; no implicit engine fallback.
Recorded 20min crowded replay below frame/simulation degradation budget.
Fresh/profile one-route/both/unknown/replay preserve cumulative keys and nonblocking static recommendation.

text.en: The River Remembers
text.es-ES: El río recuerda

text.en: 656–680 CE. Follow Dina of the Riverbank through 4 scenarios. Each begins with a factual account, then a personal recollection. All campaigns can be played independently.
text.es-ES: 656–680 CE. Sigue a Dina of the Riverbank en 4 escenarios. Cada uno comienza con un relato de los hechos y después una memoria personal. Todas las campañas se pueden jugar de forma independiente.

text.en: The shared narrator gives the historical frame. The campaign narrator is a fictional person whose memories, songs and inherited accounts offer a situated perspective. Invented dialogue is never a historical quotation.
text.es-ES: El narrador común presenta el marco histórico. El narrador de campaña es un personaje ficticio cuya memoria, cantares y relatos heredados ofrecen una perspectiva situada. Los diálogos inventados nunca son citas históricas.

text.en: A jar remembers the hand that shaped it. A family remembers more, and not always in the same way. I will tell you which memories are mine.
text.es-ES: Una vasija conserva la mano que le dio forma. Una familia guarda más, y no siempre de la misma manera. Te diré qué recuerdos son míos.

text.en: Recommended first: The Shattered Oath (CDF-I01), ali-perspective. It explains the earlier setting. You can continue now; a recap follows. This campaign begins in 656 CE, and may revisit an overlapping period.
text.es-ES: Se recomienda jugar antes El juramento quebrado (CDF-I01), ruta ali-perspective. Explica los antecedentes. Puedes continuar ahora; verás una recapitulación. Esta campaña comienza en 656 CE y puede volver a un período solapado.

text.en: The Roads Remember
text.es-ES: Los caminos recuerdan

text.en: This is a fictional technical laboratory. It checks independent campaigns, cumulative choices and recaps, without representing a historical event.
text.es-ES: Este es un laboratorio técnico ficticio. Comprueba campañas independientes, elecciones acumulativas y recapitulaciones sin representar un hecho histórico.

text.en: I keep the record of these paths. Choose one, then return to discover that remembering another does not erase the first.
text.es-ES: Guardo el registro de estos caminos. Elige uno y vuelve para comprobar que recordar otro no borra el primero.

text.en: Destroy A for Route A or B for Route B. Your record remembers both after replay. Continue with An Open Chronicle (CDF-T02).
text.es-ES: Destruye A para la ruta A o B para la ruta B. El registro recuerda ambas tras rejugar. Continúa con Una crónica abierta (CDF-T02).

text.en: Complete the preparation, then destroy A or B. If both fall at once, Route A has declared priority.
text.es-ES: Completa la preparación y destruye A oB. Si ambos caen a la vez, la rutaA tiene prioridad.

text.en: The two routes remain available on replay; completing B does not remove A.
text.es-ES: Las dos rutas siguen disponibles al rejugar; completarB no eliminaA.

text.en: The lab is32×32. Your guard starts west; the two targets are northeast and southeast.
text.es-ES: El laboratorio mide32×32. Tu guardia empieza al oeste; los dos objetivos están al noreste y sureste.

text.en: No historical event is represented. This checks engine behaviour with a fictional layout.
text.es-ES: No se representa un hecho histórico. Se comprueba el motor con una disposición ficticia.

text.en: Your essential guard was lost or the test window expired. Reload or restart.
text.es-ES: Has perdido al guardia esencial o ha terminado el plazo de prueba. Carga o reinicia.

text.en: Route A is recorded. Continue with An Open Chronicle (CDF-T02); replay may also recordB.
text.es-ES: La rutaA queda registrada. Continúa con Una crónica abierta (CDF-T02); al rejugar puedes registrarB.

text.en: Route B is recorded. Continue with An Open Chronicle (CDF-T02); replay preservesA.
text.es-ES: La rutaB queda registrada. Continúa con Una crónica abierta (CDF-T02); al rejugar se conservaA.
